nodes.name: Etching-hydrolysis with carbonate intercalation
nodes.procedure: Utilizing etching-hydrolysis and ion exchange methodologies at ambient temperature and pressure, starting from NiFe LDH-SO4^2-, they successfully synthesized NiFe LDH-CO3^2- anode through ion exchange with carbonate ions. The ion exchange process was validated using Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy in Figure 4d-h.
nodes.source_text: Lu et al. further proposed a novel strategy that integrates etching-hydrolysis process with carbonate intercalation at ambient temperature and pressure to develop an ultra-stable anode... Utilizing etching-hydrolysis and ion exchange methodologies, they successfully synthesized a cost-effective NiFe-layered double hydroxide (NiFe LDH CO3^2-) anode. The ion exchange process was validated using Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) in Figure 4d-h.
